verdict.rationale: Aircall's own API reference is a static page with no try-it functionality and only two curl samples. The vendor does link an official Postman collection from its developer portal, which gives users a runnable way to explore the API, but that collection's content could not be verified and no OpenAPI spec is published. missing for 10: interactive try-it console in the API reference, runnable examples across endpoints, verified Postman collection contents, published OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: a vendor-hosted static single page; zero try-it markup, two curl samples
Aircall's machine-readable surface is its vendor-linked Postman collection
